description:
Activate Barrenton Medic's first ability by tapping it.
Activate Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mighty Mutanimals triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Barrenton Medic.
Resolve the Barrenton Medic ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.name: Barrenton Medic
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it
